section.p: Monster configurations are in the text files in the directories ServerFolder/Data/Monster and ServerFolder/Data/MonsterSetBase.

section.title: Monster.txt
section.p: Monster.txt contains the base monster statistics and the monster IDs. Other configuration files reference the monster IDs.

row.entry: The monster's internal ID. Other configuration files reference this ID when they want to spawn the monster. Must be unique.
Legacy property. Spawn rate - used when multiple scripts try to spawn monsters. Not relevant currently because spawn logic is handled elsewhere. Leave at 1.
The monster's display name. Used in the client and logs.
The monster's level. This affects experience yield, drop tables and relative combat difficulty.
Maximum hit points. The amount of damage a monster has to take before it dies.
Maximum mana points. Used by spellcasting monsters, 0 for non-spellcasters.
The minimum damage the monster inflicts on attack.
The maximum damage the monster inflicts on attack.
Physical defense value used to calculate damage reduction
Magical defense value used to calculate damage reduction.
Used in hit chance calculations against player defense.
Used in hit chance calculations against player attack.
Maximum movement range from the spawn point in tiles. Prevents monsters wandering too far.
Defines how the monster engages in combat. 0 = Melee, 1 = Ranged, 2 = Spellcaster.
Maximum range at which a monster can attack.
The range at which the monster notices players.
Determines how fast the monster moves.
Delay between attacks. A lower value = faster attacks.
Elemental attribute. 0 = Earth, 1 = Fire, 2 = Water, 3 = Wind, 4 = Dark.
Modifier for the overall item drop chance.
Modifier for the amount of dropped Zen.
The maximum level item the monster can drop.
Skill ID that the monster uses.

Amount of resistance for different elements. 1 is ice, 2 is poison, 3 is lightning and fire, 4 is earth and wind. The value is a modification applied on the final damage, where 0 is full damage is 255 is no damage.

section.title: MonsterSetBase
section.p: The MonsterSetBase folder contains one .txt file for each zone in the game. Each .txt file contains spawn points for both friendly NPCs and hostile monsters. You can specify spawn points either as exact coordinates or as a rectangular areas where monsters spawn at random positions.

row.entry: Monster ID. Those are listed in Monster.txt
Zone ID. Those are listed in MapManager.txt
Defines randomization within the spawn position when used with a fixed spawn point, and distance between spawns in area spawn points.
Exact X coordinates for the spawn point.
Exact Y coordinates for the spawn point.
Defines which direction the NPC faces when spawned. -1 value = random direction.
Helpful reminder for debugging and configuration.
